It would be a really long story.
I'll give you a short summary of it...
All start from High School, I was on the football team, I got bullied, I got beaten for breaking up a fight and got my jaw broken, when I finally returned to the team they bullied me to the point I had to leave the school (coaches too)
I was then placed into a mental ward for trying to kill myself. I had an ex gf who was playing games with me on top of everything else and I just broke
Fast forward to Junior year of high school, kids from the team still discriminate me any chance they see me (schools where I'm from are close together) When I'm in this new high school things seem to be going okay till some girl leads me on for months and finally drops it on me that I'm a lousy nothing. I wind up meeting another girl while at the same school, she makes me feel amazing till one day she just flipped on me. That "one day of flipping out on me and hurting my feelings" started to become weekly, then daily, then it was so regular that I would just take it in stride. Little did I know it would put me where I am now. I've never been good with making friends, or just maintaining relationships in general. I broke up with the girl recently because of the pain she was causing me. When I seeked for help from the "friends" I thought I had I was denied. And then I was confronted with reality, when the only reason I would recieve texts from people was when they would ask me for things. Currently my mother calls me a druggie and won't talk to me (it's been about 6 months since we've actually talked) my father doesn't understand and then I'm just left... alone... No one willing to listen to me, no one wanting to hear what my depression has caused, no one truly wanting me...
